stem.text: A helium ion contains two protons, two neutrons and one electron.
This helium ion and a proton are passed separately through a uniform electric field.
The particles are travelling at the same velocity.
Which arrow describes the path of each particle?

stem.alt: Uniform electric field between a positive plate (+, left) and a negative plate (−, right), with five numbered arrows 1 to 5 drawn from a common point between the plates
